breaking.change: Timeline declarations consume checked TypeScript author IR directly as native tracks; the author OGT entry, text dependency reader and sibling/assets fallback are removed. Captions are captured from canonical module paths. Logical references bind the actual domain output before caching, and nested timelines are checked against the evaluated project graph.

Keys use {time,ease?,value}; imports name assets/ or sources/ subtitle paths. Flow headers, runtime loads, og render --timeline and timeline:play use base/segments/live, not segments/live.ogt or a short filename. Command-created entity names include the whole content ID to isolate module namespaces. Explicit caption locales override adjacent translations. See og api show file:timeline.
